{{Quote|It would have been a cruel revelation for the boys and girls of a century ago to learn that the intrepid Sector Ranger Novan Nune almost certainly never existed — much less followed the colonists kidnapped on Parcovey Minor to the dreaded arenas of Affavan, deep in Hutt Space, fought as a gladiator to win their freedom, and then returned to destroy the Hutt kajidic that had ravaged their world.|Albegron speaking at the Conference|<ref name="EGTWAC" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] a '''Conference on Popular Entertainment''' was held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]]. The Academician of Popular Studies [[Thunys Albegron]] spoke at the conference concerning the [[Holodrama/Legends|Holodrama]] ''[[True Tales of the Ancient Republic]]'', in particular [[Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim]], which aired in [[114 BBY]] and starred the fictional [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Ranger]] [[Novan Nune]] as the protagonist. Albegron looked at how the episode was based on a series of real events concerning the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-backed [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|assault]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Parcovey Minor]] and the [[Belasco Free Volunteers]]' journey to the planet [[Affavan]] shortly afterwards.<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The conference was first mentioned in the [[2014]] fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' series of posts by [[Jason Fry]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]]. The article featured content cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' a book released in [[2012]] by Fry.
